description: Creates a new Google Sheets spreadsheet and returns it: spreadsheetId, spreadsheetUrl, properties (title, locale, timeZone) and sheets[] with each sheet's numeric sheetId. sheet_titles creates one tab per title in order (omitted = a single default "Sheet1"). The file lands in the authorized user's My Drive root — moving it into a folder needs the Drive API, which this server does not cover. Save the returned spreadsheetId: the Sheets API has no list endpoint of its own (search_spreadsheets exists, but it needs a Drive scope on the token).

locale.description: Spreadsheet locale as ISO code, e.g. "en_US" or "ru_RU" (affects number/date parsing).

sheet_titles.description: Tab titles to create, in order, e.g. ["Data","Summary"]. Omitted = one default sheet.

time_zone.description: Time zone in CLDR format, e.g. "Europe/Moscow" (affects NOW()/TODAY()).

title.description: The spreadsheet title (also the Drive file name).

name: create_spreadsheet
title: Create a spreadsheet
